children: and its bottling partners, Coca-Cola Andina and Coca-Cola Embonor
, will invest more than 720 billion pesos ($777.55 million) in Chile over the next four years, an executive said on Tuesday.
The investment is part of Coca-Cola's plans to boost operations in the South American nation, Coca-Cola Chile head Abelardo Gudino said at an event alongside Chile's President Jose Antonio Kast.
